     * buttons, links and focus. The site header and footer stay the dark VOLTEX·
     * chrome; only the reading surface between them is light.·

     * Every colour here is a `--kb-*` token scoped to `.vx-kb-page`, with no·
     * `prefers-color-scheme` variant: a dark site, browser or OS theme never·
     * turns these pages dark. The global site tokens (--bg, --panel, --text-*)·
     * are deliberately not overridden, so the shared header, footer and support·
     * widget render exactly as on every other page.·

    .vx-kb-page {·
